Path: approvals and automation — every trigger Studio offers is one the engine runs | 缺项 (「Platform event」 writes `triggerType: 'event'`, which nothing routes) | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:workflow` · `pm:queue`. Direction (triage's call): the option leaves the select. A platform-event trigger would be new objectstack scope

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts` (the `start` inspector's trigger select and its two `showWhen` lists) ⇒ `domain:ui`.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-29T09:11Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Why p2.** It is objectui#11054's failure on a second option. A Studio author chooses 「Platform event」, and the flow binds no trigger and never fires, with no error. `resolveFlowTriggerKind` answers `undefined` for `event`, and objectstack ships trigger kinds for `api`, record change, schedule and relative time only.

**Direction: remove the option, don't invent the route.**
- The select stops offering 「Platform event」. A stored `triggerType: 'event'` loads as the select's flagged unknown value, so the author sees that it does nothing, and it is ⛔ never silently rewritten.
- Adding an `event` trigger kind the engine routes is new objectstack scope, under ADR-0041's tiers. It is not an objectui fix, and it goes to the maintainer only if a customer needs it.
- **Pins:** the option is absent. A stored `event` start node shows the unknown-value flag and saves unchanged.
- **Serial after PR objectui#11064** (objectui#11054), in the same inspector.

- A stored `triggerType: 'event'` loads as the select's flagged unknown value and saves unchanged, ⛔ never silently rewritten. Measure first whether the select already flags an unknown value, as the `webhook` value did in objectui#11054's PR. Build the flag only if it is missing, and then inside the inspector field that renders the select.
- Pins: the option is absent; a stored `event` start node shows the unknown-value flag and saves unchanged. One changeset (`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`).

⛔ No `event` trigger kind, and no change to objectstack or the spec (triage: that would be new objectstack scope under ADR-0041).
Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over this surface: no path-derived mandate, at objectstack `288611e3`)
Clause-②: no
Why no: a Studio select stops offering a value no engine routes; no schema, type, export or published accept set moves, and a stored value is kept as written.

Serial constraints cleared: read 2026-09-29T10:34Z at objectui `origin/main` `e119f120c`. PR objectui#11064 (objectui#11054, the same inspector), which triage names as the predecessor, has merged as `b31591b4a`.
